description: Defines a singleton class 'TalkAudioPlayer' responsible for playing audio data asynchronously with watchdog and playback management. Includes nested 'Playback' class for handling continuation and state synchronization.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class for managing audio playback, incorporating concurrency controls, watchdog timers, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: Inner class managing the continuation, finish state, and watchdog task for an ongoing playback.

methods.name: play(data: Data) async -> TalkPlaybackResult
methods.description: Initiates audio playback of provided data asynchronously, returning a result upon completion or interruption.

methods.name: stop() -> Double?
methods.description: Stops current playback if any, returning the current time at interruption.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool)
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when audio finishes playing.

methods.name: stopInternal(finished: Bool, interruptedAt: Double?)
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and update state.

methods.name: finish(playback: Playback, result: TalkPlaybackResult)
methods.description: Completes the playback, cancels watchdog, resumes continuation.

methods.name: armWatchdog(playback: Playback)
methods.description: Sets up a timeout task to monitor playback health and trigger stopping if needed.
